editor.description: Stop hiding deploys, migrations, and incident response in dead Confluence wikis. Compose shell-native runbooks with approval gates and an audit chain you can verify.

seo.title: NanoRun — Visual runbooks for engineers
seo.description: Open-source runbook automation for SRE and platform teams. Shell-native, approval-gated, audit-logged. Stop hiding deploys in dead Confluence pages.

openGraph.title: NanoRun — Visual runbooks for engineers
openGraph.description: The Sentry for operational procedures. Open source, dev-first, AI-native.

hero.title: Visual runbooks for engineers.
hero.subtitle: Stop hiding deploys, migrations, and incident response in dead Confluence wikis. Compose shell-native runbooks with approval gates and an audit chain you can verify with one CLI command.

0.title: Production deploys
0.description: Codify the kubectl, helm, and smoke-test sequence behind a single Run button. Approval gates pause for the on-call engineer.

1.title: Database migrations
1.description: Backup → migrate → verify → notify. Every step is shell, every step is auditable, every step is replayable.

2.title: Incident response runbooks
2.description: Triggered by Sentry, Datadog, or PagerDuty. Pre-built procedures execute under tenant-isolated runners while the on-call gets logs in real time.

0.title: Compose
0.description: Drag shell, HTTP, approval gate, and notify steps onto the canvas. Or write the YAML directly — both views stay in sync.

1.title: Run
1.description: Each step executes in a sandboxed runner (Docker self-host, Firecracker microVM in cloud). Logs stream live via xterm.js.

2.title: Audit
2.description: Every step lands in an append-only hash chain. `nanorun audit verify` walks the chain end to end.

features.headline: Built for the SRE who's tired of Confluence

0.title: Visual canvas
0.description: Compose runbooks step by step. Toggle to YAML for git versioning.

1.title: Sandboxed runners
1.description: Docker for self-host, Firecracker microVMs for cloud. Cancel propagates to live containers.

2.title: AI agent in-context
2.description: Step fails? The agent reads the last 5 step outputs and suggests the fix.

3.title: Approval gates
3.description: Pause until a human approves via Slack or the CLI. Every approval lands in the audit chain.

4.title: Tamper-evident audit
4.description: Append-only Postgres log with SHA-256 hash chain. Verifiable from a single CLI command.

5.title: Open source
5.description: AGPL server, MIT SDK and CLI. Self-host with `docker compose up`.

integrations.title: Plugs into the stack you already use
integrations.subtitle: Trigger from Sentry, Datadog, GitHub, or any HTTP webhook with HMAC verification.
integrations.items: GitHub · Slack · Sentry · Datadog · PagerDuty · Postgres · Docker · Kubernetes

0.quote: Replaced our Confluence deploy page with a NanoRun runbook in an afternoon. The Slack approval gate is the killer feature.
0.author: Sarah Jenkins

1.quote: Finally a tool that treats `kubectl` as a first-class citizen instead of hiding it behind 'visual blocks'.
1.author: Mike Chen

2.quote: Audit chain saved us in our SOC2 review. Auditor ran `nanorun audit verify` and we were done.
2.author: Elena Rodriguez
